conditions.runtime: Settlements logical server, registered living residents and owner-marked loaded storage; no forced chunk loading. Housing read requires owned town; native client render only.
conditions.limits: 64 stores/town,8192 slots/resident pass,3179 housing cells,32-block label visibility; native hunger/serving limits retained.

change.summary: Bell-marked shared food stores, durable double-chest identity, native lid/sound and actual bed-region 3D inspector.

modifiers.before: Bell links default FeedResidents=false; direct navigation can lose to native brain and missing food abandons craving.
modifiers.after: All bell-marked stores feed registered residents, including migrated links. Prefer reachable requested dish then other edible food; native brain WALK_TARGET/LOOK_TARGET, hunger/32tick serving/10daily portions retained. Explicit storage opt-in works with mobGriefing=false; loose item pickup still obeys native rule. Sleeping/hurt/threatened residents do not leave safety to feed.

modifiers.before: One coordinate per link; breaking linked half strands its remaining inventory; no world label or chest opening.
modifiers.after: Persist stable monotonic town-local chest number and both halves; loaded-only reconciliation coalesces double links and retains survivor/name. Native block lid event plus one paired sound/open/close game event; player opener counts remain authoritative. Public nearby labels expire on disconnect/distance, no world text entities.

Server-owned actual bed-centred17x11x17 snapshot with native block states, shared AmenityEvidence scoring, real category/light/duplicate/cap explanations. Native block renderer supports orbit/zoom/cutaway/exploded levels and clearly labelled illustrative example. No roof/door/furniture requirements invented; missing bound bed red, structures green, amenities blue. No client housing authority.

modifiers.before: Settlements adds JemProfession server field and extra tooltip profession line beside native Jade profession.
modifiers.after: Settlements no longer sends or renders profession; native Jade remains the sole profession display owner. Other resident mood/food/town fields preserved.
